chunks: He asks: When will the Day of Resurrection be?
ai.seo_question: When is the Day of Resurrection?
ai.summary: In Shia tradition, this verse (often linked to Surah Az-Zumar 39:67 or Al-A'raf 7:187 depending on the specific citation context) underscores that the precise timing of the Hour is exclusively within Allah's knowledge, serving as a reminder for believers to focus on spiritual preparation rather than speculative chronology. The Imams emphasize that while the event is certain, its suddenness requires constant vigilance (Muraqabah) in daily life. This uncertainty acts as a divine mercy, encouraging continuous worship and moral accountability throughout history.
